set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Overture VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Overture: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Overture
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.overture
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Ovtr
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Overture"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable across the Basilica Audio suite (copied verbatim from the Nave
# pilot - see docs/design-brief.md).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(OvertureBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/cleanPush.json
    presets/factory/classicBoost.json
    presets/factory/dropTuneTight.json
    presets/factory/smoothPush.json
    presets/factory/ownDistortion.json
    presets/factory/fuzzAdjacentLead.json
    presets/factory/parallelGrit.json
    presets/factory/deFizzCleanup.json
    presets/factory/tightRhythmGate.json
    presets/factory/circuitDrive.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # M3 photoreal GUI assets (resources/gui/, copied from the suite's
    # Blender pre-render pipeline at .scaffold/gui-assets/ - see each asset
    # family's README there for provenance/verification, and
    # basilica-audio/silentium's M3 pilot for the pattern this replicates).
    # The repo is self-contained: these copies are the ones the plugin ships
    # with.
    resources/gui/knob_brass_strip_160px_128f.png
    resources/gui/knob_brass_strip_320px_128f.png
    resources/gui/toggle_brass_strip_100px_4f.png
    resources/gui/toggle_brass_strip_200px_4f.png
    resources/gui/faceplate_overture_900x600.png
    resources/gui/faceplate_overture_1800x1200.png
    # Brand icon (already the plugin's ICON_BIG; embedded here additionally
    # so the editor can draw it in the faceplate's header roundel).
    docs/assets/icon-256.png
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE OvertureSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${OvertureSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    OvertureBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Overture PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE OvertureTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${OvertureTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Overture,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(OvertureDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(OvertureDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${OvertureDiscoveryMode})

Tenebrae.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Tenebrae VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Tenebrae: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Tenebrae
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.tenebrae
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Tnbr
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Tenebrae"
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see basilica-audio/nave's
# docs/preset-system-notes.md for the pilot implementation this was copied
# from).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(TenebraeBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/foundationChug.json
    presets/factory/lowTunedPercussive.json
    presets/factory/vintageCascade.json
    presets/factory/scoopedWall.json
    presets/factory/cutThroughLeadAdjacent.json
    presets/factory/brightAggressive.json
    presets/factory/looseAndOpen.json
    presets/factory/fullDryWetBlend.json
    presets/factory/triodeFoundation.json
    presets/factory/saggingDoom.json
    presets/factory/feedbackTightRhythm.json
    presets/factory/adaptiveGateChug.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # M3 photoreal GUI ("ritual" faceplate design) - copied verbatim from
    # brand/mocks/ritual/ (repo-relative to the suite root, one level above
    # this repo; see docs/gui-mapping.md for the full provenance and
    # parameter-mapping table). One baked master faceplate plus its two
    # master-extracted needle sprites:
    #   - master_ritual.png: the SOLE faceplate baseline (copied from
    #     master-01-base.png) - verdigris-bronze plate, 4 gargoyles,
    #     snake/thorn relief, both VU dials empty (no needles), all 4 rune
    #     knobs baked at 12 o'clock.
    #   - needle_{left,right}_ritual.png: the two master-extracted,
    #     pivot-centred VU-needle sprites (components/needle-{left,right}.png)
    #     - rotated live by src/gui/HubNeedle, one instance per dial.
    resources/gui/master_ritual.png
    resources/gui/needle_left_ritual.png
    resources/gui/needle_right_ritual.png
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE TenebraeSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${TenebraeSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    TenebraeBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Tenebrae PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE TenebraeTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${TenebraeTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Tenebrae,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
    # Absolute path to tests/fixtures, so the migration tests can load the
    # committed v0.2 state fixture regardless of the working directory ctest
    # happens to run the binary from.
    TENEBRAE_TEST_FIXTURE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures"
    # Absolute path to docs/, so tests/gui/EditorSnapshotTests.cpp can write
    # the committed docs/gui-preview.png directly rather than a copy step.
    TENEBRAE_DOCS_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs"
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(TenebraeDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(TenebraeDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${TenebraeDiscoveryMode})

Nave.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Nave VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Nave: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Nave
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.nave
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Nave
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Nave"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see docs/preset-system-notes.md).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(NaveBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/tameTheFizz.json
    presets/factory/liveStage.json
    presets/factory/darkVintage.json
    presets/factory/pushedBackInTheRoom.json
    presets/factory/touchOfRoomMic.json
    presets/factory/evenBlend.json
    presets/factory/parallelCabBlendedDry.json
    presets/factory/micMorph.json
    presets/factory/tightStack.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # M3 photoreal GUI assets (resources/gui/, copied from the suite's
    # Blender pre-render pipeline at .scaffold/gui-assets/ - see each asset
    # family's README there for provenance/verification). The repo is
    # self-contained: these copies are the ones the plugin ships with. No
    # toggle filmstrip or VU-meter assets: Nave's layout-manifest.json has
    # zero toggle params and no meter bays (see PluginEditorLayout.h).
    resources/gui/knob_brass_strip_160px_128f.png
    resources/gui/knob_brass_strip_320px_128f.png
    resources/gui/faceplate_nave_900x600.png
    resources/gui/faceplate_nave_1800x1200.png
    # Brand icon (already the plugin's ICON_BIG; embedded here additionally
    # so the editor can draw it in the faceplate's header roundel).
    docs/assets/icon-256.png
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE NaveSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${NaveSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_formats
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    NaveBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Nave PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE NaveTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${NaveTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Nave,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(NaveDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(NaveDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${NaveDiscoveryMode})

Silentium.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Silentium VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Silentium: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SilentiumSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${SilentiumSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    SilentiumBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Silentium PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SilentiumTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

# tests/tools/ holds standalone offline executables (each with its own main()),
# not Catch2 test translation units - they must never be linked into the Tests
# binary. See the GoldenRenderHarness target below.
list(FILTER SilentiumTestSources EXCLUDE REGEX "/tests/tools/")

add_executable(Tests ${SilentiumTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

# tests/AllocationGuard.{h,cpp} replaces the global operator new/delete so the
# real-time tests can assert that processBlock() never allocates. Clang and GCC
# treat the library operators as builtins with no observable side effects, which
# lets an optimised build elide allocations outright and reorder the counter
# reads around the ones it keeps - in a Release build the guard then counts zero
# for everything, including its own deliberate-allocation self-test, and every
# "allocates nothing" assertion silently becomes vacuous. These flags are the
# documented way to tell them a replacement with side effects exists. MSVC does
# not perform the transform and needs no equivalent.
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
    target_compile_options(Tests PRIVATE -fno-builtin-operator-new -fno-builtin-operator-delete)
endif()

# juce_cryptography is linked into the test/tooling targets ONLY (never into
# the shipped plugin, which has no use for it): tests/GoldenFixture.h uses
# juce::SHA256 for the cross-version golden-render digests.
target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2 juce::juce_cryptography)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Silentium,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(SilentiumDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(SilentiumDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${SilentiumDiscoveryMode})

# ==============================================================================
# Offline tooling
# ==============================================================================
#
# GoldenRenderHarness regenerates tests/data/GoldenRenders.h - the cross-version
# golden artifacts the neutrality tests (T1/T4/T20) compare against. It is only
# ever run by hand, at a checkout of the PREVIOUS release's engine sources; see
# tests/data/README.md and the file header for the exact procedure. It is built
# as part of the normal build (rather than EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL) purely so it cannot
# silently rot out of sync with the fixture header it shares with the tests.
# ==============================================================================

add_executable(GoldenRenderHarness "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/tools/GoldenRenderHarness.cpp")

target_compile_features(GoldenRenderHarness PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(GoldenRenderHarness PRIVATE SharedCode juce::juce_cryptography)

target_compile_definitions(GoldenRenderHarness PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Silentium,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

Requiem.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Requiem VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Requiem: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Requiem
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.requiem
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Rqem
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Requiem"
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see docs/preset-system-notes.md in nave).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(RequiemBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/cathedralWash.json
    presets/factory/concertHall.json
    presets/factory/chamberRoom.json
    presets/factory/choirBloom.json
    presets/factory/tightRhythmicHall.json
    presets/factory/frozenDrone.json
    presets/factory/darkSanctuary.json
    presets/factory/brightSlapChamber.json
    presets/factory/fullWetSendHall.json
    presets/factory/subtleAir.json
    presets/factory/livingCathedral.json
    presets/factory/breathingChamber.json
    presets/factory/bloomingHall.json
    presets/factory/vintageLushPlate.json
    presets/factory/dialogueDuckedScore.json
    presets/factory/infiniteFrozenNave.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # M3 photoreal GUI ("alchemie" faceplate design) - copied verbatim from
    # brand/mocks/alchemie/ (repo-relative to the suite root, one level
    # above this repo; see docs/gui-mapping.md for the full provenance and
    # parameter-mapping table). One baked UNLIT master faceplate plus its
    # small set of live-overlay source assets:
    #   - master_alchemie.png: the SOLE faceplate baseline (copied from
    #     master-03-glows-off.png) - aubergine panel, silver engravings,
    #     moon-dial bezel (unlit), 5 crystal knobs (unlit ring channels),
    #     2 buttons, 2 dark glass windows.
    #   - needle_alchemie.png: the master-extracted, pivot-centred moon-dial
    #     needle sprite (components/needle.png) - rotated live by
    #     src/gui/HubNeedle.
    #   - glow_knob_{1..4}.png / glow_bezel.png: the design's ADDITIVE light
    #     diff sprites (components/glow-knob-N.png / glow-bezel.png) -
    #     src/gui/AdditiveGlow composites these onto master_alchemie.png at
    #     runtime (see that class's own compositing-model docs). Note the
    #     LIT reference master (master-01-base.png) is intentionally NOT
    #     embedded here - it is only needed by the round-trip test in
    #     tests/gui/AdditiveGlowTests.cpp, which loads
    #     tests/data/alchemie-master-01-base-lit-reference.png directly
    #     from disk (see REQUIEM_TEST_DATA_DIR below), never via BinaryData.
    resources/gui/master_alchemie.png
    resources/gui/needle_alchemie.png
    resources/gui/glow_knob_1.png
    resources/gui/glow_knob_2.png
    resources/gui/glow_knob_3.png
    resources/gui/glow_knob_4.png
    resources/gui/glow_bezel.png
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE RequiemSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${RequiemSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_formats
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    RequiemBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Requiem PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE RequiemTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${RequiemTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Requiem,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
    # Absolute path to tests/data, so tests/gui/AdditiveGlowTests.cpp can
    # load the LIT reference master (alchemie-master-01-base-lit-
    # reference.png) as a one-time round-trip test fixture, off the runtime
    # BinaryData path (see CMakeLists.txt's RequiemBinaryData docs above).
    REQUIEM_TEST_DATA_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/data"
    # Absolute path to docs/, so tests/gui/EditorSnapshotTests.cpp can write
    # the committed docs/gui-preview.png directly rather than a copy step.
    REQUIEM_DOCS_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs"
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(RequiemDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(RequiemDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${RequiemDiscoveryMode})

formant-preservation engine behind the doubler's `Shift` mode (see
`docs/architecture.md`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
- Pinned commit: `57b93f4e9206a089a45387eaa39bdc9f310d3308` (header version 1.3.2)
- Licence: MIT

The pin is a development-head commit rather than the newest release tag
(`1.1.0`) on purpose: the formant API this plugin relies on
(`setFormantSemitones()`, `setFormantBase()`) was added after `1.1.0` and has
not yet been tagged. The pin is a full commit SHA, so the resolved source is
exact and reproducible.

## Signalsmith Linear

A transitive dependency of Signalsmith Stretch (its STFT/FFT backend). Seraph
does not include it directly; it is added to the include path so that
`signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h` resolves
`signalsmith-linear/stft.h`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear
- Pinned tag: `0.3.1`
- Licence: MIT

Seraph deliberately consumes this package as headers only, without its own
CMakeLists: that CMakeLists defaults `SIGNALSMITH_USE_ACCELERATE` to `ON` for
Apple targets and defines `ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK`, whose symbols are not
available at Seraph's macOS 11.0 deployment target. The portable C++ FFT path
is used instead.

Seraph.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Seraph VERSION 0.4.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Seraph: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Signalsmith Stretch - the v0.3.0 "Shift" doubler mode's STFT pitch shifter
# (docs/architecture.md, brief ss3.0/ss3.2). MIT-licensed and therefore
# AGPLv3-compatible; the copyright notices live in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
#
# Both packages are DOWNLOAD_ONLY: their own CMakeLists would pull
# signalsmith-linear via FetchContent (bypassing CPM_SOURCE_CACHE) and, on
# Apple targets, switch signalsmith-linear onto Accelerate/ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK
# by default - whose new-LAPACK symbols are not available on this project's
# 11.0 deployment target. Adding the two include directories by hand keeps the
# header-only portable C++ FFT path, which is what the CPU budget in the brief
# (ss3.2: <= 8% of one core for four Shift voices) was measured against.
#
# Pinned to the 1.3.2 development head rather than the 1.1.0 release tag
# deliberately: the formant API the brief mandates (setFormantSemitones/
# setFormantBase, ss3.2) does not exist in any tagged release yet. See
# THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and the v0.3.0 CHANGELOG entry.
CPMAddPackage(
    NAME signalsmith-linear
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY Signalsmith-Audio/linear
    GIT_TAG 0.3.1
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    DOWNLOAD_ONLY TRUE
)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME signalsmith-stretch
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
    GIT_TAG 57b93f4e9206a089a45387eaa39bdc9f310d3308
    DOWNLOAD_ONLY TRUE
)

add_library(SignalsmithStretch INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(SignalsmithStretch SYSTEM INTERFACE
    "${signalsmith-stretch_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${signalsmith-linear_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Seraph
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.seraph
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Srph
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Seraph"
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable across the suite (see sibling plugin nave's
# docs/preset-system-notes.md, the M2 pilot's replication recipe).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(SeraphBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/leadCutThrough.json
    presets/factory/leadIntimateCloseMic.json
    presets/factory/choirWideSpread.json
    presets/factory/choirTightBlend.json
    presets/factory/spokenGrowledInterlude.json
    presets/factory/glueOnly.json
    presets/factory/deEssOnlySurgical.json
    presets/factory/wideDoubleNoDynamics.json
    presets/factory/choirSacredShift.json
    presets/factory/doublerVintageMicro.json
    presets/factory/leadTightStackHumanized.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # Suite typography (M3 vector editor, issue #4): EB Garamond, OFL
    # licensed (resources/fonts/OFL-EBGaramond.txt) - consumed by
    # src/gui/BasilicaLookAndFeel.cpp as the single source of every glyph
    # the fully JUCE-drawn editor renders.
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-Regular.ttf
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-SemiBold.ttf
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SeraphSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${SeraphSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    SeraphBinaryData
    SignalsmithStretch
)

target_link_libraries(Seraph PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE SeraphTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${SeraphTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Seraph,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(SeraphDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(SeraphDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${SeraphDiscoveryMode})

Aureate.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Aureate VERSION 0.5.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Aureate: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Aureate
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.aureate
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Aurt
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Aureate"
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see sibling basilica-audio/nave's
# docs/preset-system-notes.md, the pilot this was copied from).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(AureateBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/stringSectionGlue.json
    presets/factory/brassBloom.json
    presets/factory/choirWarmth.json
    presets/factory/orchestralSubmixCohesion.json
    presets/factory/masterGlueSubtle.json
    presets/factory/vintageTapePad.json
    presets/factory/valvePush.json
    presets/factory/parallelGritNewYork.json
    presets/factory/consoleSummingSheen.json
    presets/factory/airAndWeight.json
    presets/factory/orchestralBusGlue.json
    presets/factory/softTubeGlue.json
    presets/factory/ironBusWeight.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # M3 photoreal GUI ("tubecomp" faceplate design, the pilot for the
    # requiem/tenebrae/apotheosis wave) - copied verbatim from
    # brand/mocks/tubecomp/ (repo-relative to the suite root, one level
    # above this repo; see docs/gui-mapping.md for the full provenance and
    # parameter-mapping table). Exactly one baked master faceplate plus its
    # small set of live-overlay source assets:
    #   - master_tubecomp.png: the SOLE faceplate baseline (copied from
    #     master-03-clean-base.png) - steel plate, wooden cheeks, handle,
    #     empty VU dial, all 10 knobs at 12 o'clock, all 4 toggles UP, tube
    #     vents at full glow, 3 blank brass nameplates.
    #   - needle_tubecomp.png: the master-extracted, pivot-centred VU-needle
    #     sprite (components/needle.png) - rotated live by src/gui/HubNeedle.
    #   - toggle_{1..4}_down.png: per-toggle pre-cropped "lever down" pose
    #     (components/toggle-N-down.png) - blitted over the baseline by
    #     src/gui/ToggleZoneSwap when that toggle's own parameter is away
    #     from its default (see ToggleZoneSwap.h's UP==default convention).
    #   - vent_glow_tubecomp.png: the tube-vent glow diff layer
    #     (components/vent-glow.png) - src/gui/SubtractiveGlow builds a
    #     "fully dim" frame from this once at construction and cross-blends
    #     it against the baseline live (see that class's own runtime-model
    #     docs).
    resources/gui/master_tubecomp.png
    resources/gui/needle_tubecomp.png
    resources/gui/toggle_1_down.png
    resources/gui/toggle_2_down.png
    resources/gui/toggle_3_down.png
    resources/gui/toggle_4_down.png
    resources/gui/vent_glow_tubecomp.png
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE AureateSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${AureateSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    AureateBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Aureate PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE AureateTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${AureateTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Aureate,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
    # Absolute path to tests/data, so binary test fixtures (currently the
    # v0.2.1 reference render used by the v0.3.0 neutrality null, brief
    # section 6 test 6.1c) can be located from the build directory without
    # copying them around or depending on the working directory.
    AUREATE_TEST_DATA_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/data"
    # ...and to presets/factory, so the SHA-256 pinning test reads the same
    # files juce_add_binary_data() embedded rather than a copy of them.
    AUREATE_PRESET_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/presets/factory"
    # Absolute path to docs/, so tests/gui/EditorSnapshotTests.cpp can write
    # the committed docs/gui-preview.png directly rather than a copy step.
    AUREATE_DOCS_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs"
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(AureateDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(AureateDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${AureateDiscoveryMode})

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Firmament VERSION 0.4.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Firmament: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Firmament
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.firmament
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Frmm
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Firmament"
    # Relative paths are resolved against this CMakeLists.txt's directory and
    # validated at configure time (JUCE 8.0.14, JUCEModuleSupport.cmake's
    # _juce_make_absolute_and_check).
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable across the suite (basilica-audio/nave's docs/preset-system-notes.md
# is the replication recipe this was copied from).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(FirmamentBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/openStrings.json
    presets/factory/choirBloom.json
    presets/factory/doubledRhythmGlue.json
    presets/factory/masterBusBassMono.json
    presets/factory/automatedWidthSafetyNet.json
    presets/factory/monoSafeAir.json
    presets/factory/widePadFullPrecedence.json
    presets/factory/extremeWidth.json
    presets/factory/subtleOpenness.json
    presets/factory/velvetWidth.json
    presets/factory/masteringLinearPhaseBassMono.json
    presets/factory/threeBandImager.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # Suite typography (M3 vector editor, issue #4): EB Garamond, OFL
    # licensed (resources/fonts/OFL-EBGaramond.txt) - consumed by
    # src/gui/BasilicaLookAndFeel.cpp as the single source of every glyph
    # the fully JUCE-drawn editor renders.
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-Regular.ttf
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-SemiBold.ttf
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE FirmamentSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${FirmamentSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    FirmamentBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Firmament PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE FirmamentTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${FirmamentTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Firmament,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(FirmamentDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(FirmamentDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${FirmamentDiscoveryMode})

Triptych.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Triptych VERSION 0.6.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Triptych: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Triptych
    COMPANY_NAME "Yves Vogl"
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.triptych
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Trpt
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Triptych"
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see docs/preset-system-notes.md in
# basilica-audio/nave, the pilot implementation this was copied from).
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_binary_data(TriptychBinaryData SOURCES
    presets/factory/default.json
    presets/factory/densityGlue.json
    presets/factory/peakControl.json
    presets/factory/lowEndTighten.json
    presets/factory/deHarshHighs.json
    presets/factory/masteringSafetyCeiling.json
    presets/factory/parallelStyleDensity.json
    presets/factory/hardLimiterCeiling.json
    presets/factory/glueMaster.json
    resources/i18n/de.txt
    # Suite typography (M3 vector editor, issue #4): EB Garamond, OFL
    # licensed (resources/fonts/OFL-EBGaramond.txt) - consumed by
    # src/gui/BasilicaLookAndFeel.cpp as the single source of every glyph
    # the fully JUCE-drawn editor renders.
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-Regular.ttf
    resources/fonts/EBGaramond-SemiBold.ttf
)

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE TriptychSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${TriptychSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list. juce_gui_basics is
# needed explicitly for the M2 PresetBar (AlertWindow/FileChooser/PopupMenu) -
# most plugin editors already pull it in via juce_audio_utils, but linking it
# explicitly costs nothing extra and matches the nave pilot.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    TriptychBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Triptych PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE TriptychTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${TriptychTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Triptych,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(TriptychDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(TriptychDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${TriptychDiscoveryMode})

Apotheosis.cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Must be set before the first project() call to take effect.
# CI overrides CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES explicitly for release/universal builds;
# local builds are left at the native architecture.
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "11.0" CACHE STRING "Minimum macOS deployment target" FORCE)

# JUCE's build tooling (juceaide) and some CMake find-modules it triggers
# (e.g. FindThreads) expect the C toolchain to be available; declaring it
# here at the top level avoids it being enabled implicitly deeper inside
# JUCE's CMake helpers, which has been observed to break Ninja's generate
# step (missing CMAKE_C_COMPILE_OBJECT rule variable).
project(Apotheosis VERSION 0.6.1 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Release" CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)

# CPMAddPackage automatically respects the CPM_SOURCE_CACHE environment
# variable if it is set, reusing a shared package cache across builds/checkouts.
if(DEFINED ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE})
    message(STATUS "Apotheosis: using CPM_SOURCE_CACHE at $ENV{CPM_SOURCE_CACHE}")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME JUCE
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY juce-framework/JUCE
    GIT_TAG 8.0.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Plugin target
# ==============================================================================

juce_add_plugin(Apotheosis
    # The trading name, not the legal person. This is the string a host groups
    # plugins by - Logic's plugin manager, Cubase's vendor column, Reaper's FX
    # browser - and the suite ships under one brand. Display only: the VST3
    # class ID derives from PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE + PLUGIN_CODE alone (JUCE
    # 8.0.14, juce_VST3ModuleInfo.h, VST3Interface::jucePluginId) and the Audio
    # Unit identity triple stays (aufx, Apotheosis's PLUGIN_CODE, Yvsv), so no
    # existing session is disturbed. See docs/branding.md.
    COMPANY_NAME "Basilica Audio"
    # DELIBERATELY NOT RENAMED to com.basilicaaudio.*, and not an oversight.
    # The bundle ID is how a host recognises this plugin across sessions, and
    # how every preset file ever written names it ("plugin" field). Changing it
    # makes every existing project treat this as a different plugin, for no
    # user-visible benefit - nothing a customer sees flows from it. Recorded in
    # basilica-audio/.github docs/adr/0001-suite-vendor-identity.md.
    BUNDLE_ID com.yvesvogl.apotheosis
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Yvsv
    PLUGIN_CODE Apth
    FORMATS AU VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Apotheosis"
    COMPANY_WEBSITE "https://basilica-audio.github.io/website/"
    # Names the legal person, not the trading name above, and stays that way:
    # Basilica Audio is how the suite is sold, Yves Vogl is who holds the
    # copyright. Aligning the two would make this notice less accurate.
    COMPANY_COPYRIGHT "Copyright (c) 2026 Yves Vogl"
    DESCRIPTION "Lookahead true-peak brickwall limiter for the master bus"
    VST3_CATEGORIES Fx Dynamics Mastering
    ICON_BIG "docs/assets/icon.png"
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD TRUE
    IS_SYNTH FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
)

# ==============================================================================
# Embedded assets: M2 preset system factory presets (presets/factory/*.json)
# and the M2 i18n frame's German translation (resources/i18n/de.txt). See
# src/presets/PresetManager.h and src/presets/Localisation.h - both consume
# these purely via BinaryData:: symbols passed in from PluginProcessor.cpp/
# PluginEditor.cpp, never by including BinaryData.h themselves, so they stay
# portable to sibling plugins (see docs/preset-system-notes.md pattern,
# pioneered by basilica-audio/nave).
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# SharedCode: an INTERFACE target carrying the plugin's sources, definitions,
# and library links so that both the plugin targets (AU/VST3/Standalone) and
# the Tests executable compile the exact same code (Pamplejuce pattern, see
# https://github.com/sudara/pamplejuce), avoiding ODR violations between them.
# ==============================================================================

add_library(SharedCode INTERFACE)

target_compile_features(SharedCode INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

file(GLOB_RECURSE ApotheosisSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

target_sources(SharedCode INTERFACE ${ApotheosisSources})

target_include_directories(SharedCode INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")

target_compile_definitions(SharedCode INTERFACE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    # AGPLv3 usage permits disabling the splash screen.
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
    # processBlock() holds a juce::ScopedNoDenormals, which forces FTZ/DAZ for
    # the whole audio callback, so juce_dsp's per-block snap-to-zero passes are
    # redundant work on the audio thread. juce_dsp.h (JUCE 8.0.14) documents
    # disabling the flag as safe exactly in this case. It also keeps denormal
    # tail tests honest: the library no longer masks a missing FTZ path.
    # Fleet decision: basilica-audio/Crypta#99.
    JUCE_DSP_ENABLE_SNAP_TO_ZERO=0
)

# Add any extra juce:: modules a specific plugin needs (e.g. juce_audio_formats
# for reading impulse-response files) to this list.
target_link_libraries(SharedCode INTERFACE
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
    ApotheosisBinaryData
)

target_link_libraries(Apotheosis PRIVATE SharedCode)

# ==============================================================================
# Tests
# ==============================================================================

enable_testing()
set(CTEST_OUTPUT_ON_FAILURE ON)

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME Catch2
    GITHUB_REPOSITORY catchorg/Catch2
    GIT_TAG v3.15.2
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE ApotheosisTestSources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.h")

add_executable(Tests ${ApotheosisTestSources})

target_compile_features(Tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE SharedCode Catch2::Catch2)

# Copy over the plugin target's compile definitions (JucePlugin_* macros etc.)
# so plugin code compiles identically when built as part of the Tests binary.
target_compile_definitions(Tests PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:Apotheosis,COMPILE_DEFINITIONS>
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
    # Absolute path to docs/, so tests/gui/EditorSnapshotTests.cpp can write
    # the committed docs/gui-preview.png directly rather than a copy step.
    APOTHEOSIS_DOCS_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs"
    # Test-only hooks in SharedCode (deterministic dither seeding for the
    # golden-fixture harness, the T2 ceiling-clamp bypass) - never defined
    # for the plugin targets, so shipping binaries carry none of them.
    APOTHEOSIS_TESTING=1
    # Absolute path to the tests/ source directory, so the Tests binary can
    # locate the committed golden fixtures (tests/fixtures/v020) regardless
    # of the build/working directory ctest happens to use.
    APOTHEOSIS_TESTS_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests"
)

# juce::SHA256 for the golden-fixture manifest integrity hashes
# (tests/RegressionTests.cpp) - Tests binary only, not the plugin.
target_link_libraries(Tests PRIVATE juce::juce_cryptography)

set_target_properties(Tests PROPERTIES XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME ON)

include(${Catch2_SOURCE_DIR}/extras/Catch.cmake)

if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Xcode")
    set(ApotheosisDiscoveryMode PRE_TEST)
else()
    set(ApotheosisDiscoveryMode POST_BUILD)
endif()

catch_discover_tests(Tests DISCOVERY_MODE ${ApotheosisDiscoveryMode})
